title: Apple Patches Actively Exploited Zero-Day in iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and macOS Apple patched a zero-click vulnerability (CVE-2026-86950) in iOS 26
content_md:
Apple Patches Actively Exploited Zero-Day in iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and macOS Apple patched a zero-click vulnerability (CVE-2026-86950) in iOS 26

via Mastodon https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/apple-patches-actively-exploited-zero-day-in-ios-26-ipados-26-and-macos-p-i-5-p-7/gD2P6Ple2L

CVE-2026-86950.evidence: Event reports Apple patched CVE-2026-86950, a zero-click out-of-bounds write in CoreGraphics, as an actively exploited zero-day in iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and macOS.
